text: What's going on between you and my girlfriend?
zh: 你和我女朋友之间怎么回事？
zh_hant: 你和我女朋友之間怎麼回事？

text: What do you mean, what's going on?
zh: 你什么意思，什么怎么回事？
zh_hant: 你什麼意思，什麼怎麼回事？

text: I told her I was doing the show.
zh: 我告诉她我要上这个节目。
zh_hant: 我告訴她我要上這個節目。

text: And she said, oh my God, I love Conan.
And I said, I said, well, what the, what?
She said, what, I'm just saying I love Conan.
zh: 她说，什么，我只是说我喜欢柯南。
zh_hant: 她說，什麼，我只是說我喜歡柯南。

text: How come you keep saying it twice?
And how come when the last, the second time you say it, you kind of say it like somber and to yourself?
zh: 还有为什么第二次说的时候，你有点闷闷不乐地自言自语？
zh_hant: 還有為什麼第二次說的時候，你有點悶悶不樂地自言自語？
